caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned at an angle, showing both the front and the right side. The frame of the chair consists of light brown wooden posts, with four legs, vertical and horizontal supports, and turned decorative elements, especially at the tops of the back posts and on the uppermost horizontal bars. The back of the chair includes two vertical slats and one central horizontal rail, all in the same light brown wood. The arms are also wooden, connecting the front posts to the back posts. The seat is covered with a green cushion that appears padded and has visible creases and texture. The edges of the cushion are trimmed with a lighter decorative fringe. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects present, focusing attention solely on the chair.
title: Carver Armchair
